title: Seared Sashimi Tuna with Italian-Style Salsa Verde
description: A fusion of Peruvian sashimi and Italian flavors, this dish features seared tuna served with a tangy salsa verde.
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the tuna steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear the tuna for 1-2 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Transfer the tuna to a plate and let rest.
In a food processor, combine parsley, basil, garlic, capers, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Process until the salsa verde is well combined and slightly smooth.
Serve the seared tuna with the salsa verde spooned over the top.
